# algosec_device (Data Source)

Look up one device by exact unique tree name using the administrator-visible inventory. Display names are not unique. Passwords are discarded.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algosec_device" "example" {
  name = "ExampleDevice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique device tree name.

### Read-Only

- `device` (Attributes) Allowlisted device information. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--device))
- `id` (String) Device tree name.

<a id="nestedatt--device"></a>
### Nested Schema for `device`

Read-Only:

- `baseline_profile` (String) Baseline profile.
- `brand` (String) Brand.
- `brand_name` (String) Brand name.
- `collector` (String) Collector.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `host_name` (String) Host name.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `node_type` (String) Node type.
- `original_name` (String) Original name.
